verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a built-in chat interface for local models, with regenerate paging, nested chat folders, themes and document attachment (RAG). Community users independently confirm 'a UI to chat with models easily' and call the UI powerful, though some report rough edges such as an unclear empty state and a heavier UI than alternatives. missing for 10: polished UX per community reports (empty-state and discoverability issues noted).
